verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents its own background autonomy: Ari keeps the Model current, rebuilds it overnight, refreshes connections nightly at a user-configurable time, and messages users when something changes. The pricing page lists "Proactive alerts & triggers." The configurable nightly refresh is a real recurring schedule, but there is no documentation of users defining their own automations or triggers (conditions, actions, schedules) beyond that sync time, and the triggers feature appears only as a pricing bullet. Missing for 10: documented user-defined automation/trigger configuration, recurring schedules for arbitrary agent tasks, depth on how alerts are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
